exposure: BNP levels higher or less than 20 pg/mL
Presence or absence of B-lines on thoracic ultrasound
Thoracic ultrasound A- and B-line artifacts
outcome: Volume of fluids administered in the first 24 hours
cohort: 80 pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: A statistically significant difference was found in the volume of fluids administered in the first 24 hours between patients with B-lines on thoracic ultrasound and those without.
